_note: Generated from the Move declarations under sources/events/, with the JSON encoding rules verified against live Sui mainnet GraphQL on 2026-08-26. These are the shapes an off-chain decoder must accept. The vector<u8> encoding was settled in s6 against published testnet package 0x109fba1479e19843b2b6ed8d225b9fb341c85cc274ca5ae90bcf40242f0c7a0b, on six live events read back both from the executing client and from the fullnode; every other rule still comes from the 2026-08-26 mainnet GraphQL run.

_encoding.u64 / u128 / u256: JSON string, because the value can exceed 2^53
_encoding.Option<T>: T's encoding, or null when none
_encoding.vector<u8>: CONFIRMED (s6, testnet). Base64 JSON string, NOT an array of numbers. A 32-byte commit sent as 00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff twice reads back as "ABEiM0RVZneImaq7zN3u/wARIjNEVWZ3iJmqu8zd7v8=". This is a special case: vector<u16> and vector<ID> are still arrays. A decoder must base64-decode every `commit`, `previous_commit`, `file_set_root`, `previous_root`, `digest` and any other vector<u8> field.
_encoding.vector<vector<u8>>: JSON array of base64 strings. Each element is a vector<u8> and follows that rule; the outer vector follows the vector<T> rule. Applies to LayoutRegistered.paths and .content_hashes.

_filters.grpc: EventTypeFilter { event_type: "<PACKAGE>" } returns every event the protocol raises, whichever module declares it.
_filters.json_rpc: suix_queryEvents is deactivated on public fullnodes as of 2026-08-26 and returns -32601 Method not found.

<PACKAGE>::storage_events::ForeignBlobsA.summary: Blobs sourced outside the protocol were taken into its custody, in one config.
<PACKAGE>::storage_events::ForeignBlobsA.note: The per-user ForeignMeta index this used to name is deleted. It covered only the adopted subset of a user's configs and said nothing about that. Two sources replace it: this event, and BlobConfig.owner, which answers ownership from the config object and survives a missed event. An adoption is one config per call, so the former config_ids vector is now a single config_id and blob_count says how many blobs went into it.

<PACKAGE>::storage_events::LayoutRegiste.summary: A compaction's receipt was written onto the config it produced.
<PACKAGE>::storage_events::LayoutRegiste.note: The object keeps the two roots and the counts, which is constant in the file count; this keeps the members they commit to, so a consumer can still enumerate a generation after the quilt holding it has been deleted. paths and content_hashes are positionally paired and arrive in ascending path order, which is the order the root is folded in; superseded arrives in ascending id order. Every element of paths and content_hashes is a vector<u8> and therefore arrives base64 inside a JSON array. kind is 0 for raw blobs and 1 for a quilt. generation is strictly greater than every generation superseded. There is no accept, reject or expiry event because there is no accept, reject or expiry: the only consent signal is the owner's subsequent BlobWithdrawn.
